grajewski_2025.citation: Czesław Grajewski, ‘Antyfony „Inclita” o św. Katarzynie w źródłach od XII do XVIII w. Próba systematyzacji’, Musica Ecclesiastica 20 (2025), p. 78 n. 11.
grajewski_2025.access: Direct web-reader text of pp. 76–79 and 81–84; no saved PDF and no original manuscript image inspected.
grajewski_2025.assertion: According to the author, Vatican Pal. lat. 527 is a compilatory manuscript with two Catherine offices, both beginning with the same shortened Inclita antiphon. The office variants are Ave virgo speciosa and Inclita sanctae virginis.
grajewski_2025.limits: This is the author's report, not an image-verified occurrence; the source passage does not establish two identical service rubrics or the same text within both complete offices. It is not independent expert review of the present project.

heidelberg_description.access: Search-result indexed institutional catalogue text; direct find requests failed as described below.
heidelberg_description.assertion: Institutional description identifies Pal. lat. 527 as a late-14th-century Speyer breviary, reports at least two alternating hands, and links to a facsimile.
heidelberg_description.limits: Catalogue summary does not confirm the two office headings or prove that they were written by one hand.

cambrai_index.access: Search-indexed record only; no original manuscript image inspected.
cambrai_index.assertion: Cantus identifies the related antiphon as 202513 and records a longer text at Cambrai 38 f.378v; this gives comparative context for the corrected Fr 8304 reading.
cambrai_index.limits: Reference exposure is not independent verification, and same text does not establish book identity or equivalent liturgical role.
